<!--
  Thanks for taking the time to open an issue for Starbit (衔星 | Harness-Agent)!

  Please read before you start:
  1. Search open AND closed issues to make sure this has not been reported before.
  2. General "how do I ..." questions are better asked in GitHub Discussions when enabled,
     or as a `question:` issue otherwise.
  3. Keep only the section that matches your report and delete the rest, together with
     all HTML comments.

  Security vulnerabilities must never be filed here — see SECURITY.md.
-->

# Issue Report

## 0. Issue type

- [ ] Bug report
- [ ] Feature request
- [ ] Enhancement / performance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Question / support

Suggested labels for maintainers: `bug` `enhancement` `feature` `docs` `question`
Suggested title prefixes: `bug:` `feat:` `enhancement:` `docs:` `question:`

---

Use this section when the product does not behave as documented or expected.

Use this section for problems in documentation, built-in prompts (under `docs/prompts`),
error messages, or the `.en` translations.

## 4. Question / support

- Goal: what are you trying to accomplish?
- Attempted: what have you tried so far?
- Context: which docs, prompts, or config did you consult?

## 5. Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues (open and closed) and found no duplicate.
- [ ] I removed all sections and comments that do not apply.

- [ ] My title starts with the matching prefix from section 0.

Thank you for helping make Starbit better!
